evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep said 'This should take about five to ten minutes of your time then you'll be able to build you an accurate code you can depend on, sounds good.' — time-boxed and promise of dependable quote present, but rep did not genuinely pause for confirmation before continuing to probing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asked 'Do you have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer during this call today?' — but this came after already asking for name and probing availability, placing it after initial logistics have started.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'No' to concerns question; N/A per rubric.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No concerns were raised by customer; N/A per rubric.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep gathered property type (duplex to house), stories (1 and 2), rooms (1 bedroom), parking access (driveway, no access issues), additional items (egg chairs, washer/dryer, dressers, desk, coffee table), special considerations (items under £500, no fragile/valuable items). All seven logistics items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep never asked 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?' — packing was not offered.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep asked 'How many number of boxes are we moving?' and customer answered 'probably no boxes' — box count was probed, though the rubric's anchor language about 'typical box count for a home your size' was not used.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep said 'A typical one bedroom worth of items would normally takes two movers. That's between two and a half to three and a half hours... estimated time is between two and a half to three and a half hours estimated cost is from $548 to $728.' Typical range provided and personalized to customer's specific prep level (dressers need to be emptied) and route (20 minutes, 1-story to 2-story).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep disclosed hourly rate ($104/mover), truck inclusion, gas/taxes/insurance, 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments, and stated 'no hidden fees of any type, no credit card fees, no transportation fees, no stable fees.' Fee transparency and commitment framing both present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' — went directly from estimate into availability booking without confirming customer comfort with pricing.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep said 'Finally you have on time guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.' Discount terms clearly stated.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep said 'First is that we have no worry damage coverage included on the already weight that you're paying us. We will provide up to 2000 dollars per move. That is to repair replace and reimburse for iPhone. Your items.' — coverage amount and inclusion (not add-on) stated, but no explicit 'no deductible / no fine print' framing used.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep did not ask a closing confirmation like 'Does that put those to rest?' — instead moved directly to booking. No explicit loop closure on the Two Promises.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep never asked 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or any genuine final-check variant. Went directly from estimate/promises into booking without returning to concerns.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep never asked 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' — no catch-all statement made.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep asked 'Would you like our help with your move' plainly, with no built-in out like emailing the quote.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep did not mention rate-lock or confirm that the price is reserved/locked for this booking.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Rep obtained: moving date (15th of October), contact number (ending 5289), email (scooot83@icloud.com), two addresses (pick-up and destination). Rep did not confirm arrival window explicitly (said 'morning or afternoon' but no time selected), crew size was mentioned (2 movers) but not confirmed as booked, and no crew notes about customer concerns were left. Partial — some details confirmed, window and notes missing.

top_strength: Rep systematically gathered all seven logistics details, provided a personalized estimate anchored to typical range, and fully disclosed the On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage.
coaching_note: Section 6 (final concerns check and catch-all) and Section 7 (rate-lock confirmation and detailed booking confirmation with crew notes) were both skipped entirely; add those bookend moments to prevent short-handed closings.
